levels.title: Roll to the Bowl
levels.goalText: Help the berry roll all the way into Lory's bowl!
levels.teaches: plank: a tilted plank makes a ball roll downhill
levels.hintText: The berry falls off the shelf... put your plank under it, tilted toward the bowl, and it will keep on rolling!

levels.title: Boing! Over the Wall
levels.goalText: Bounce the berry over the wall and into the bowl!
levels.teaches: trampoline: launches a falling ball back up high
levels.hintText: See where the berry plops onto the floor? Put the trampoline right there and it will bounce sky-high over the wall!

levels.title: Windy Day
levels.goalText: Blow the beach ball into the bell to ring it!
levels.teaches: fan: steady wind pushes light balls along
levels.hintText: The beach ball is so light! Put the fan on the shelf behind it, blowing toward the bell. Whoooosh!

levels.title: Domino Rally
levels.goalText: Fill the gap so the dominoes topple all the way to the bell!
levels.teaches: domino: dominoes knock each other over in a chain
levels.hintText: There is a hole in the domino line! Stand your three dominoes in the gap, close together, so nobody misses the tap.

levels.title: Heavy Helper
levels.goalText: Drop the heavy marble to fling the berry up into the bell!
levels.teaches: marble: heavy balls fall hard and can work a seesaw
levels.hintText: The berry sits on one end of the seesaw. Hold the marble high above the OTHER end and let it drop. Boing... ding!

levels.title: Berry Express
levels.goalText: Catch the falling berry and ride it over to the bowl!
levels.teaches: conveyor: a moving belt carries things sideways
levels.hintText: Catch the berry on your conveyor belt like a little train, pointing toward the bowl. All aboard!

levels.title: Balloon Boost
levels.goalText: Let a balloon nudge the berry off its perch into the bowl!
levels.teaches: balloon: rises slowly and gently pushes light things
levels.hintText: The berry is teetering on the edge! Let go of the balloon right underneath it — it floats up and gives a friendly bump.

levels.title: Pop Goes the Balloon
levels.goalText: Blow the balloon into the spiky ceiling to pop it!
levels.teaches: fan + spikes: wind steers a rising balloon into spikes
levels.hintText: The balloon floats straight up — but the spikes are over THERE. Put the fan in its path, blowing toward the spikes!

levels.title: Bumper Boing
levels.goalText: Bounce the beach ball off the bumper to ring the bell!
levels.teaches: bumper: super bouncy, sends balls flying
levels.hintText: Put the bumper on the floor right where the ball lands. Bumpers are SO springy the ball will rocket up to the bell!

levels.title: Two-Step Tumble
levels.goalText: Use a plank AND a trampoline to send the berry over the wall!
levels.teaches: combo: plank ramp into trampoline launch
levels.hintText: First a slide, then a bounce! Catch the berry with a gently tilted plank, and put the trampoline where it lands next.

levels.title: Marble Rally
levels.goalText: Drop a marble down the ramp and fix the domino line to ring the bell!
levels.hintText: Two jobs this time! Fill the domino gap, then hold the marble above the ramp and let it roll to start the show.

levels.title: Double Pop
levels.goalText: Pop BOTH balloons using two fans working together!
levels.teaches: combo: fan relay, one wind stream hands off to another
levels.hintText: One fan can't blow that far. Make a wind relay: a low fan to start them moving, and a higher fan to carry them to the spikes!

levels.title: The Long Way Home
levels.goalText: Carry the berry LEFT with a conveyor, then bounce it into the bowl!
levels.teaches: combo: choosing conveyor direction + trampoline placement
levels.hintText: Everything goes LEFT today! Set the conveyor's arrows toward the bowl, and let the trampoline bounce the berry over the wall.

levels.title: The Great Berry Machine
levels.goalText: Build the whole chain: dominoes push the berry, trampoline bounces it, plank slides it home!
levels.teaches: grand combo: domino chain + trampoline + plank in one machine
levels.hintText: Follow the story: marble tips the dominoes, the last one nudges the berry off the shelf, the trampoline bounces it up, and a tilted plank slides it into the bowl. Fill the domino gap first!

notes: Conventions used: all x/y are object CENTERS. angle is in degrees, positive = clockwise, i.e. the RIGHT end tips DOWN (so angle 12 rolls a ball rightward; angle -10 rolls it leftward). Balls placed in mid-air (fixed or tray) are at rest until PLAY, then fall. Floor-level parts (trampolines, bumpers, bowls, bells on the ground) are placed at y=655-660 per the y<=660 rule and settle the few pixels onto the y=690 floor at PLAY. Design logic: levels 1-9 each teach exactly one tray part with an almost-complete machine and one obvious gap (plank, trampoline, fan, domino, marble+seesaw, conveyor, balloon, fan-into-spikes pop, bumper); levels 10-14 combine 2-3 taught ideas with 2-4 tray parts, never more than 3 distinct types. All trajectories were sanity-checked against the stated physics (g approx 970 px/s^2 from '350px in 0.85s', ramp exit speeds derated approx 40 percent for rolling friction, trampoline return = 110 percent of fall height, fan reach 280px, domino spacing 40px within the 30-45px topple window, toppled-domino tip reach approx 56px past its base). Robustness margins: bowls are 130 wide with computed landing points within approx 30px of bowl center; the level 14 trampoline-to-plank handoff is self-correcting (a missed first bounce re-bounces higher and drifts further right into the plank); pop levels use widened spike clusters (120-180px) as forgiving targets. Bucket was deliberately not used because its redirect behavior is underspecified; no level depends on it. Sparkles are placed on the intended ball/balloon path (start arc, mid mechanism, final approach) so a successful run collects all three.
